name: Kuroyuki
source:
Gekkamaru's younger brother and the protagonist's foster brother. Right after he was born he and Gekkamaru were taken in by her family.
Cheerful, carefree and clever, he can also be quite cunning.
He was sent away on an extended mission when he was eight, and after 8 years, has finally returned.
